text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any swelling or pain in your abdomen, or felt a mass when you press on your stomach? I also need to know if you have had any fevers or shortness of breath recently.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a personal or family history of malignancy, or any recent travel to areas endemic for tuberculosis? I also need to know if you have experienced any difficulty swallowing or breathing due to the neck swelling.
